tagline.text: Cebu's second Mactan bridge across the Mactan Channel

location.label: Location
location.text: Mactan Channel, linking Mandaue City and Lapu-Lapu City (Mactan Island), Cebu

best_season.label: Best time to visit
best_season.text: Year-round (the December–May dry season is most pleasant)

budget.label: Budget
budget.text: About ₱0–300 (per person; no toll, includes transport)

children.text: Marcelo Fernan Bridge is an extradosed cable-stayed bridge about 1.2 km long that opened on August 3, 1999, linking Mandaue on mainland Cebu with Lapu-Lapu on Mactan Island. There is no toll and sidewalks run along both sides, so you can walk across for views of the channel, and Millennium Park beneath the Mactan end is a good place to look up at the structure and the sea.

Marcelo Fernan Bridge links Mandaue City on mainland Cebu with Lapu-Lapu City on Mactan Island. It was the second of the bridges across the Mactan Channel, and many people still call it the "Second Bridge." Construction began in 1996 and it opened on
August 3
, 1999, originally as the Second Mactan–Mandaue Bridge.

It was built with Japanese government assistance, and Kajima and Sumitomo Construction are named as contractors. Its structure is described as an extradosed bridge, similar to a cable-stayed bridge but with a lower, stiffer tower, and its longest span is about
. Published lengths vary by source, from
, but it is generally given as about
1.2 km
. It has four vehicle lanes and sidewalks on both sides.

The reason for the bridge was traffic congestion. The older Sergio Osmeña Jr. Bridge (the first bridge), which opened in 1973, was effectively the only land link between Mactan Island and the mainland, so a new bridge was built to ease the load. Together with the Cebu–Cordova Link Expressway (CCLEX), which opened in April 2022, there are now three routes across the Mactan Channel. The bridge received its present name by Republic Act 8795 on
June 27
, 2000, the year after it opened, when it was renamed from the Consolacion Bridge to honor Marcelo Fernan, a Chief Justice from Cebu.

Its appeal as a destination is modest but clear. Walking across, you see the channel and the cities on both sides, and Millennium Park beneath the bridge has benches facing the sea and exercise space. Since everyone traveling between the Mactan airport and resort area passes this bridge, it is easy to fit in as a short stop for sunset or night views when you have time.

Sidewalks on both sides let you cross on foot. Even walking only to the midpoint opens up views of the channel and the city, and the height brings a cool breeze. In 2019, walking a bicycle across the bridge was allowed.
The most eye-catching sight is the H-shaped tower at the center with cables fanning out. The bridge's name is lettered on the tower, and photos looking up from below are popular.

A free park by the sea beneath the Mactan end of the bridge, with open space for running and cycling, sports courts, huts, benches facing the ocean, and a skate area. It is decorated with murals and graffiti, and is a good place to photograph the bridge structure from below.
The Filipino Seafarers Memorial stands inside the park. It is a monument that recalls the Philippines' role as a global source of seafarers, and makes a nice addition to a walk through the park.

Some descriptions say the sky and water turn red around sunset, and there are many photos of the bridge and tower lit at night. However, no official lighting schedule was confirmed, so enjoy it spontaneously depending on the weather.

blocks.title: WaterWorld and Mandaue Bridge Park on the Mandaue side

children.text: At the Mandaue end of the bridge is WaterWorld Cebu, described as Cebu's largest water park, and beneath the bridge is the roughly one-hectare Mandaue Bridge Park, which opened in 2013.

blocks.title: The man behind the name, Marcelo Fernan

children.text: The bridge is named for Marcelo B. Fernan, born in Cebu in 1927. He is described as having served as both Chief Justice and Senate President. He resigned as Senate President on
June 28
, 1999 for health reasons and died on
July 11
, a few weeks before the bridge opened.
The Osmeña Bridge, opened in 1973, is a two-lane steel truss about
long. The Fernan Bridge is a four-lane extradosed bridge. CCLEX, opened in 2022, is a toll expressway of about
8.9 km
from Cebu's SRP to Cordova. Crossing all three in turn shows how Cebu's traffic has changed.

items.title: Sunset walk route
items.subtitle: 1–2 hours starting from the Mactan side

children.text: Arrive at Millennium Park on the Mactan side. It is only a few meters from the main road, but you have a short walk to the entrance.
Walk around the park to see the murals and the seafarers memorial, and take photos looking up at the structure and cables from beneath the bridge.
Climb up to the sidewalk and walk to the midpoint of the bridge. Setting out about
40 minutes
before sunset gives you plenty of time.
Watch the sun set over the channel from the bridge. On cloudy days the sky color differs, so every evening is different.
After the sun sets and the sky deepens, return along the sidewalk and have a snack at a stall near the park or call a taxi or Grab.
Motorcycles and cars pass in large numbers on the bridge, so it is noisy. Always hold children's hands and walk on the inner side of the sidewalk.

items.title: A short stop on the way
items.subtitle: A 30-minute stop between the airport and downtown

children.text: On the way from downtown to Mactan, have the taxi stop briefly and get out at the park on the Mactan side.
Take photos of the structure from beneath the bridge and rest on a bench facing the sea.
Call a taxi or Grab again and head to your next stop.
The park is said to have no parking lot, so a taxi or Grab is easier than driving yourself.

items.title: Three-bridge tour route
items.subtitle: Comparing the Osmeña Bridge and CCLEX as well

children.text: Start on the Mandaue side and walk to the midpoint of the Fernan Bridge.
At Millennium Park on the Mactan side, look up at the bridge structure and take photos.
Take a taxi south to the Osmeña Bridge (about
1.6 km
) and compare its steel truss structure.
After lunch, take the CCLEX to see the Cordova side from the car window, then return to SRP.
CCLEX charges a toll, listed from October 2025 at about ₱107 for a car and about ₱68 for a 110–399 cc motorcycle.
There are several direct flights a day from Manila's Ninoy Aquino International Airport to Mactan-Cebu Airport, taking about
1 hour 30 minutes
Mactan airport is about
2 km
in a straight line from the bridge (calculated from coordinates), so it is a short taxi or Grab ride from the airport.
Flight routes and times change by season, so check the airline's notices when you book.
On the Mactan side, access is via Old Patiller Road. The park is only a few meters from the main road, but you have to walk to the entrance.
Tricycles, taxis, and Grab are easiest, and since the park is said to have no parking lot, public transport is better.
On the Mandaue side, access is via United Nations Avenue. City buses, jeepneys, taxis, and Grab pass along this road.
WaterWorld Cebu stands at the Mandaue end of the bridge, which makes it easy to find.
Sidewalks on both sides let pedestrians cross. The view is good even if you only walk to the midpoint.
Bicycles must be walked across on the sidewalk. In September 2019 there was briefly a ban and a nighttime pedestrian restriction, but they were soon withdrawn.
The dry season,
December–May
, has clear skies and is good for sunsets and night views. At midday, however, the sidewalk on the bridge has no shade and is very hot. A late-afternoon walk after the sun has dropped is recommended.
Traffic builds up during rush hour. When crossing by vehicle, avoid these hours, and for a walk, late afternoon or early evening when traffic is lighter is better. In the rainy season,
June–November
, showers are frequent, so check the forecast.

There is no lodging on the bridge itself, but it is close to both the Mactan resort area and downtown Cebu City, so wherever you stay you can drop by during your trip. Because the airport is close in a straight line, it also works as a short outing when your flight time is awkward. Travel time from downtown Cebu City varies a lot with traffic, so leave extra time at rush hour. If you only want a quick look at the bridge before or after a flight, it is easier to leave your luggage at your hotel or at the airport and move lightly.

Near Millennium Park there are said to be simple snack stalls and karaoke businesses. For a proper meal, it is better to eat at shops on the Mandaue side or restaurants on Mactan Island. Restaurant names and menus change often, so check locally. The huts inside Millennium Park are used for family gatherings and rest, and the terms of use follow local guidance.
To see the sunset, arrive about
40 minutes
before sundown and look around the park and bridge first.
There is no shade on the bridge. Bring a hat, sunscreen, and water, and avoid walking at midday.
Some stretches of sidewalk are narrow, so walk single file and walk your bicycle across.
Millennium Park has no parking lot. Use a taxi or Grab, or stop nearby and walk in.
For photos, looking up from beneath the bridge shows the H-shaped tower and cables best. A wide-angle lens helps.
Vehicle noise on the bridge is loud at rush hour. It is better to walk at a quiet time.
When taking out your phone or camera on the bridge, use a strap so it does not drop past the railing.
Trash cans may be scarce nearby, so take your trash with you.
The bridge deck is a fast road for vehicles. Walk on the inner side of the sidewalk, and always hold the hands of children and pets.

From 10 September 2025 DPWH Region 7 closed the northbound lane (Lapu-Lapu to Mandaue) from 11 PM to 5 AM for deck repairs, with completion targeted for October. We found no report of completion or reopening, so we could not confirm whether the work has ended, so check the latest traffic notices when you travel.
In September 2019, a bicycle ban and a pedestrian restriction from 1 to 5 AM were announced and then withdrawn. No later rule change was found, but follow signs on site.
The area around the park can become empty at night. After dark, stay with your group and keep valuables out of sight.
Millennium Park has no parking lot and public transport access can be inconvenient, so allow extra time in your schedule.
Figures such as length and opening date differ slightly among sources. The numbers in this guide are approximate.
The island you reach by crossing the bridge, Cebu's main resort area where the airport, resorts, and beaches are found.
A memorial site on Mactan Island, a historic sight commemorating Lapulapu and the battle with Magellan. You can reach it from the bridge by taxi.
The city on the mainland side of the bridge, with WaterWorld Cebu at the bridge's end and a look at everyday city life.
Cebu's gateway airport, close to the bridge in a straight line. It is easy to take a quick look at the bridge on your arrival or departure day.
